evidence.evidence_text: Our empirical results suggest that every transformer module in BERT can act as a winning ticket: fine-tuning each specific module while keeping the rest of the network frozen can lead to comparable performance to the full fine-tuning.

Among different modules, LayerNorms exhibit the best capacity for knowledge transfer with limited trainable weights, to the extent that, with only 0.003% of all parameters in the layer-wise analysis, they show acceptable performance on various target tasks.
